description: Two municipal emissions packages have distinct thresholds and identities. The newer description reports CO2-equivalent totals from facilities emitting over 10 kt and lists CSV, spreadsheet, JSON and XML exports for 2004–2018. The older package describes a 50 kt threshold, one CSV and a start date of 2013. Its gas description inconsistently names nitrous oxide with formula NO2; that issue remains unresolved. The packages are grouped as related facility-emissions statistics, without asserting equal reporting populations or numerical continuity. The threshold change is not dated or explained in the inspected metadata. The CUDC source records name the Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs, present file access and numerical contents are unverified. Specific simulation uses remain unstated unless identified above. No workbook, document or linked data body was fetched.
